_comment: Identifiers this pack references but does not define. The audit treats any
reference that resolves to nothing as a broken link unless it matches one of
these patterns, so a typo in a borrowed identifier is still caught while a
legitimate borrow is not. `*` matches any run of characters.
`vanilla` is content the game itself always provides; a match is silent.
`companion_packs` is content another pack provides. Those resolve only when
that pack is loaded alongside this one, and Minecraft logs a content error
when it is not, so a match is reported as a warning rather than passing
quietly. Keeping the reference is a deliberate trade: interoperability when
the companion is present, a log line when it is absent.
Adding a pattern is a claim that something else provides that identifier.
Prefer the narrowest pattern that covers the reference.

_note: Structura renders build guides as ghost blocks. This pack replaces the
armor stand client entity outright, so Structura's render controller and
scale animation have to be named here for the two packs to work
together with this one on top.
